thread:
Ashwin: Heads up — saw steady KV-cache resident growth during long-chat runs (32k tokens) on H100 and MI250. After ~1.5h the worker OOMs even though token throughput looks normal.
Marta: ugh, can you paste the minimal repro? heap/pmap dump?
Ashwin: repro is `./run_infer --model paged-kv-6b --device mix --long-context 32768 --stream` — attach last lines from gpu mem log: 
```
[2026-03-17 15:42:03] kv_cache: pages_alloc=124512 pages_active=122340 pages_free=2172
[2026-03-17 16:56:11] kv_cache: pages_alloc=146089 pages_active=144980 pages_free=1109
[2026-03-17 17:15:32] kv_cache: OOM at alloc_page(), requested=4096
```
Yun: interesting — on MI250 we see `kv_evict_count` rising much slower than on H100 in perf counters. Kernel selection differs: ROCm picks `tiling_v2` kernel for paged attention which appears to touch extra staging buffers.
Mike: I ran a short profiler. Summary: H100 evict latency median 0.9ms, MI250 3.8ms; evict throughput H100 ~1800 pps, MI250 ~520 pps. Means background compaction can't keep up on MI250.
Ashwin: also saw fragmentation traces — many tiny holes <4 pages; reuse heuristic misses them. Repro snippet from trace tool: 
```
# frag histogram (pages)
size=1: 42123
size=2: 9301
size=4: 1322
size>=8: 87
```
Marta: could be our reuse window + allocator granularity. Did you try forcing LRU compaction on every N allocs?
Ashwin: patched locally to call `compact_free_list()` every 50 evicts — mem growth stops, but perf drops ~6% overall. Still better than OOM.
Yun: I dug into the kernel: `tiling_v2` does an extra temporary `kv_scratch` alloc per block on MI250 due to kernel launch requiring align >256. That bumped peak VRAM and delayed evictions.
Mike: can we short-term: 1) force `tiling_v1` on ROCm for paged-attn via env var 2) enable compaction N=50 3) add telemetry counters for hole sizes? Tried 1) and it reduced resident by ~20% and evict latency to 1.2ms.
Ashwin: @dev-deploy-bot rolled a canary to staging with `ROCM_TILE_FORCE=v1 KV_COMPACT_FREQ=50` — logs show stabler runs.
perf-bot: perf link: https://perf.internal/reports/5301234567-kv-longctx-mi250 (profiling summary attached) :thumbsup:
Marta: action items:
- Yun: propose kernel-selection fallback PR to avoid `tiling_v2` on MI250 for paged kernels (start with heuristic: long-context && per-alloc-scratch > 128k)
- Ashwin: submit compaction POC to runtime repo, include opt-in env var and perf tests
- Mike: add hole-size histogram to KPIs and dashboard (chart + alert if >10% pages in size=1 bucket)
- Ops: keep canary for 48h, watch for regressions

Yun: I'll add microbench harness to reproduce fragmentation quickly (single process, synthetic interleaved prompt lengths). Expect PR tomorrow.
Ashwin: thanks all — moving to follow-ups. If someone on-call sees a longctx OOM, please capture `kv:dump_holes` and ping this thread. :pray:
